title: Implement progressive worldwide search without per-country fanout
note: Native proposal validation, accepted merge and task completion remain separate required gates. This receipt does not mark the backlog complete.
known_limitations: This receipt is not a native completion or merge receipt.
scripts/worldwide/build-global-routing.ts, src/lib/worldwide/search/global.ts, and tests/worldwide/worldwide-search.test.ts are untracked working-tree files. site_revision is HEAD before those edits.
artifacts/ is gitignored, so this receipt is on disk and is not part of git status. Its own sha256 is not stored inside this file.

Worldwide search walks a hierarchical term directory or a hierarchical citation directory. It does not issue one request per country and it does not load posting payloads, document bodies, or embeddings.
The Pages document is the routing root only. Child directories and shard summaries stay remote. fullCorpusBundled and shardSummariesBundled stay false.
A directory that would exceed maxDirectoryBytes is split by key range. A shard summary that would exceed maxShardSummaryBytes drops hits from the tail and sets summariesTruncated.

Default page bounds are 8 artifact requests, 4 shard summaries, 1 MiB, and concurrency 4. The implementation accounts those loads in order and reports batches of at most 4. It does not perform network I/O; the caller supplies an in-memory routing index.
A cursor is bound to the catalog revision, normalized query or citation, allow-list filters, page size, and page budgets. A different binding is cursor-mismatch.
Common terms open at most maxShardRequestsPerPage summaries and keep the unopened shard pointers for continuation. Repeating a cursor returns the same page.

matchTotal is null while any directory or shard remains, a summary was truncated, the query was token-capped, or any collection is not known with a numeric indexedRecords. Routing document frequency is not reported as a total.
matchTotal on a finished known catalog is the count of emitted summary hits. claimsAllWorldwideResults is false, and the label does not say all worldwide results.
Continuation reads the remaining queued directories and shards. A wave remainder is emitted before another shard is opened, and an already visited summary is not loaded again.
Summary scores are caller-supplied integers used only for stable order. This module does not rescore BM25 and does not fuse ranks. Titles are stored up to 256 characters.
Missing, unknown, and unavailable collections stay in the coverage display and have no shard. Partial collections that are searched remain partial.
Strict filters are allow-lists. They remove shard pointers and hits. They do not add a country and they are not score weights.
Place-scoped authority stack selection stays in the planner. This module does not decide that an instrument binds conduct.
